faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions

checkinCheckout.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
checkinCheckout.a: Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is until 11:00 AM. Please contact us in advance if you need special arrangements.

cancellation.a: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival. Cancellations made after that are charged 50% of the first night.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Cash, bank transfers, and credit/debit cards. You can also book through Booking.com.

breakfast.a: No, breakfast is not included in the rates. The equipped kitchen lets you prepare your own meals, and there are cafés and bakeries nearby.

distanceTorres.q: How far are you from Torres del Paine?
distanceTorres.a: We're about 112 km (a 1.5-hour drive) from the entrance to Torres del Paine National Park.

supermarkets.a: Yes, there are supermarkets less than 1 km away, just a 2-minute drive.

airportTransfer.a: We can arrange airport transfers for an additional charge. Contact us for more information.

pets.a: Yes, we accept small pets in some cabins for an additional charge. Please let us know when booking.

parking.a: Yes, all cabins include free private parking.

heating.a: All our cabins have efficient heating systems to keep you comfortable year-round.

kitchen.q: Do the cabins have an equipped kitchen?
kitchen.a: Yes, all of them have a full kitchen: utensils, refrigerator, stove, and microwave.

wifi.a: Yes, we offer free high-speed Wi-Fi in all our cabins.

pets.a: Unfortunately, pets are not allowed, to keep a hypoallergenic environment for all our guests.

kitchen.q: Do the apartments have an equipped kitchen?
kitchen.a: Yes, all of them have a full kitchen: utensils, refrigerator, stove, and microwave.

wifi.a: Yes, free high-speed Wi-Fi in all apartments.

parking.a: Yes, we have parking included for our guests.

access24.a: Yes, access is free 24 hours a day.
